        file_okay=False,
        resolve_path=True,
        help="Compile session directory. Omit when auditing an artifact directly.",
    ),
    artifact: Path | None = typer.Option(
        None,
        "--artifact",
        exists=True,
        file_okay=True,
        dir_okay=False,
        resolve_path=True,
        help="README or case study to audit.",
    ),
    evidence: Path | None = typer.Option(
        None,
        "--evidence",
        exists=True,
        file_okay=True,
        dir_okay=False,
        resolve_path=True,
        help="Evidence JSON for artifact-only verification.",
    ),
    fail_on: str = typer.Option(
        "needs_evidence,rejected",
        "--fail-on",
        help="Comma-separated statuses that fail: needs_evidence, rejected, attested, or none.",
    ),
    check: bool = typer.Option(
        False,
        "--check",
        help="Read-only verification; do not rewrite session artifacts.",
    ),
) -> None:
    """Re-run deterministic verification on a session, README, or case study."""
    if session is None and artifact is None:
        raise typer.BadParameter("Provide SESSION or --artifact.")
    if artifact is None and evidence is not None:
        raise typer.BadParameter("--evidence requires --artifact.")
    try:
        fail_statuses = parse_fail_on(fail_on)
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise typer.BadParameter(str(exc)) from exc

    session_report = None
    artifact_report = None
    try:
        with span("verify.claims", op="verify"):
            if session is not None:
                session_report = verify_session(session, write=not check)
            if artifact is not None:
                if evidence is not None:
                    scan = load_evidence_file(evidence)
                elif session is not None:
                    scan = load_evidence_file(session / "evidence.json")
                else:
                    raise typer.BadParameter(
                        "--artifact requires --evidence when SESSION is omitted."
                    )
                artifact_report = audit_artifact(artifact, scan.evidence)
    except DoxifyError as exc:
        error(str(exc))
        raise typer.Exit(code=1) from exc

    if session_report is not None:
        _print_verification(session_report.summary)
    if artifact_report is not None:
        _print_artifact_verification(artifact_report, fail_statuses)

    failed = []
    if session_report is not None:
        failed.extend(failing_claims(session_report.claims, fail_statuses))
    if artifact_report is not None:
        failed.extend(failing_claims(artifact_report.claims, fail_statuses))

    if failed:
        console.print(
            f"[red]Verification failed:[/red] {len(failed)} claim(s) matched --fail-on."
        )
        raise typer.Exit(code=1)
    console.print("[green]Verification passed.[/green]")

    table = Table(title="Verification", show_header=False)
    table.add_column("Status", style="cyan")
    table.add_column("Count", justify="right")
    table.add_row("Verified", str(summary.verified))
    table.add_row("Attested", str(summary.attested))
    table.add_row("Needs evidence", str(summary.needs_evidence))
    table.add_row("Rejected", str(summary.rejected))
    console.print(table)


def _print_artifact_verification(
    report: ArtifactReport,
    fail_on: set[ClaimStatus],
) -> None:
    summary = report.summary
    table = Table(title=f"Artifact: {report.path.name}", show_header=False)
    table.add_column("Field", style="cyan")
    table.add_column("Value")
    table.add_row("Mode", report.mode)
    table.add_row("Sections", str(len(report.sections)))
    table.add_row(
        "Attested sections",
        str(sum(1 for section in report.sections if section.attested)),
    )
    if report.unmarked_sections:
        table.add_row("Unmarked sections", str(len(report.unmarked_sections)))
    table.add_row(
        "Claims",
        f"{summary.verified} verified, {summary.attested} attested, "
        f"{summary.needs_evidence} needing evidence, {summary.rejected} rejected",
    )
    console.print(table)

    failures = failing_claims(report.claims, fail_on)
    for claim in failures[:10]:
        console.print(f"[red]{claim.id} {claim.status.value}[/red] {claim.text}")
        if claim.reason:
            console.print(f"  {claim.reason}")
    if len(failures) > 10:
        console.print(f"  ... and {len(failures) - 10} more")

from __future__ import annotations

import importlib.metadata
import logging
import os
import threading
import time
from collections.abc import Iterator
from contextlib import contextmanager
from contextvars import ContextVar

import sentry_sdk
import sentry_sdk.logger as sentry_logger
from sentry_sdk import crons
from sentry_sdk.consts import OP, SPANDATA
from sentry_sdk.integrations.dedupe import DedupeIntegration
from sentry_sdk.tracing import Span, Transaction

from .redaction import (
    SAFE_DATA_COLLECTION,
    SAFE_LOG_FIELDS,
    redact_text,
    redact_value,
    safe_url,
    sanitize_breadcrumb,
    sanitize_event,
    sanitize_log,
    sanitize_transaction,
)

DEFAULT_MONITOR_SLUG = "doxify-nightly"
DEFAULT_TRACES_SAMPLE_RATE = 0.2
MONITOR_CONFIG = {
    "schedule": {"type": "crontab", "value": "0 3 * * *"},
    "checkin_margin": 10,
    "max_runtime": 15,
    "timezone": "UTC",
    "failure_issue_threshold": 2,
    "recovery_threshold": 1,
}

_log = logging.getLogger(__name__)
_lock = threading.Lock()
_initialized = False
_current_transaction: ContextVar[Transaction | Span | None] = ContextVar(
    "doxify_transaction", default=None
)
_current_stage: ContextVar[Span | None] = ContextVar("doxify_stage", default=None)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class MonitoringStatus:
    enabled: bool = False
    initialized: bool = False
    dsn_configured: bool = False
    environment: str = "development"
    release: str | None = None
    traces_sample_rate: float = DEFAULT_TRACES_SAMPLE_RATE
    logs_enabled: bool = False
    error: str | None = None


_status = MonitoringStatus()


def _env_bool(name: str, *, default: bool) -> bool:
    raw = os.environ.get(name)
    if raw is None:
        return default
    return raw.strip().lower() not in {"0", "false", "no", "off", ""}


def _env_float(name: str, *, default: float) -> float:
    raw = os.environ.get(name)
    if raw is None:
        return default
    try:
        value = float(raw)
    except ValueError:
        return default
    return min(max(value, 0.0), 1.0)


def _release() -> str:
    configured = os.environ.get("SENTRY_RELEASE")
    if configured:
        return configured
    try:
        version = importlib.metadata.version("doxify")
    except importlib.metadata.PackageNotFoundError:
        version = "0.1.0"
    return f"doxify@{version}"


def _environment() -> str:
    return os.environ.get("SENTRY_ENVIRONMENT", "development")


def _dsn() -> str | None:
    dsn = os.environ.get("SENTRY_DSN", "").strip()
    if not dsn:
        return None
    if not _env_bool("DOXIFY_SENTRY", default=True):
        return None
    return dsn


def _monitor_slug() -> str | None:
    return os.environ.get("SENTRY_MONITOR_SLUG")


def init_monitoring() -> bool:
    """Initialize Sentry only when an explicit DSN is configured.

    Initialization failures are non-fatal: the CLI continues without telemetry.
    """
    global _initialized, _status

    with _lock:
        if _initialized:
            return _status.enabled

        dsn = _dsn()
        traces_sample_rate = _env_float(
            "SENTRY_TRACES_SAMPLE_RATE", default=DEFAULT_TRACES_SAMPLE_RATE
        )
        logs_enabled = _env_bool("SENTRY_SEND_LOGS", default=True)
        status = MonitoringStatus(
            enabled=False,
            initialized=True,
            dsn_configured=dsn is not None,
            environment=_environment(),
            release=_release(),
            traces_sample_rate=traces_sample_rate,
            logs_enabled=logs_enabled,
        )

        if dsn is None:
            _status = status
            _initialized = True
            return False

        try:
            sentry_sdk.init(
                dsn=dsn,
                release=status.release,
                environment=status.environment,
                traces_sample_rate=traces_sample_rate,
                profiles_sample_rate=0.0,
                data_collection=SAFE_DATA_COLLECTION,
                default_integrations=False,
                auto_enabling_integrations=False,
                integrations=[DedupeIntegration()],
                before_send=sanitize_event,
                before_breadcrumb=sanitize_breadcrumb,
                before_send_transaction=sanitize_transaction,
                before_send_log=sanitize_log,
                enable_logs=logs_enabled,
                max_breadcrumbs=20,
                max_value_length=1024,
                server_name="doxify-cli",
                project_root=str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]),
                debug=_env_bool("SENTRY_DEBUG", default=False),
                attach_stacktrace=False,
                auto_session_tracking=False,
            )
        except Exception as exc:
            _status = MonitoringStatus(
                enabled=False,
                initialized=True,
                dsn_configured=True,
                environment=status.environment,
                release=status.release,
                traces_sample_rate=traces_sample_rate,
                logs_enabled=logs_enabled,
                error=redact_text(exc),
            )
            _initialized = True
            _log.warning("Sentry initialization failed; continuing without monitoring.")
            return False

        _status = MonitoringStatus(
            enabled=True,
            initialized=True,
            dsn_configured=True,
            environment=status.environment,
            release=status.release,
            traces_sample_rate=traces_sample_rate,
            logs_enabled=logs_enabled,
        )
        _initialized = True
        _log.warning(
            "Sentry monitoring enabled: errors and timings only. "
            "Disable with DOXIFY_SENTRY=0 or an empty SENTRY_DSN."
        )
        return True


def reset_monitoring() -> None:
    """Reset module state. Intended for tests."""
    global _initialized, _status
    _initialized = False
    _status = MonitoringStatus()
    _current_transaction.set(None)
    _current_stage.set(None)


def monitoring_status() -> MonitoringStatus:
    return _status


def is_monitoring_enabled() -> bool:
    return _status.enabled


def report_exception(
    exc: BaseException,
    *,
    command: str | None = None,
    stage: str | None = None,
) -> None:
    if not _status.enabled:
        return
    try:
        with sentry_sdk.new_scope() as scope:
            if command:
                scope.set_tag("command", command)
            if stage:
                scope.set_tag("stage", stage)
            scope.set_context(
                "doxify",
                {
                    "command": command or "unknown",
                    "stage": stage or "unknown",
                    "provider": "unknown",
                },
            )
            sentry_sdk.capture_exception(exc)
    except Exception:
        _log.debug("Failed to report exception to Sentry.", exc_info=True)


def flush_monitoring(timeout: float = 2.0) -> None:
    if not _status.enabled:
        return
    try:
        sentry_sdk.flush(timeout=timeout)
    except Exception:
        _log.debug("Failed to flush Sentry events.", exc_info=True)


def capture_log(level: str, event: str, fields: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    if not _status.enabled or not _status.logs_enabled:
        return
    attributes = {
        key: redact_value(value)
        for key, value in fields.items()
        if key in SAFE_LOG_FIELDS and isinstance(value, (str, int, float, bool))
    }
    attributes["doxify.event"] = redact_text(event)
    try:
        level_name = {"critical": "fatal"}.get(level, level)
        logger = getattr(sentry_logger, level_name, sentry_logger.info)
        logger(event, attributes=attributes)
    except Exception:
        _log.debug("Failed to send structured log to Sentry.", exc_info=True)


def set_measurement(name: str, value: float, unit: str = "") -> None:
    if not _status.enabled:
        return
    transaction = _current_transaction.get()
    if transaction is None:
        return
    try:
        transaction.set_measurement(name, float(value), unit)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return


def set_tag(name: str, value: str) -> None:
    if not _status.enabled:
        return
    transaction = _current_transaction.get()
    if transaction is None:
        return
    transaction.set_tag(name, value)


def begin_stage(name: str) -> None:
    if not _status.enabled:
        return
    end_stage()
    transaction = _current_transaction.get()
    if transaction is None:
        return
    span = transaction.start_child(op="doxify.stage", name=name)
    span.set_data("doxify.stage", name)
    _current_stage.set(span)


def end_stage(status: str = "ok") -> None:
    if not _status.enabled:
        return
    span = _current_stage.get()
    if span is None:
        return
    try:
        span.set_status(status)
        span.finish()
    finally:
        _current_stage.set(None)


@contextmanager
def command_transaction(command: str) -> Iterator[None]:
    if not _status.enabled:
        yield
        return

    started = time.perf_counter()
    transaction = sentry_sdk.start_transaction(
        name=f"doxify.{command}",
        op="cli.command",
    )
    transaction.set_tag("command", command)
    transaction.set_data("doxify.command", command)
    token = _current_transaction.set(transaction)
    failed = False
    exit_code = 0

    try:
        with transaction:
            try:
                yield
            except SystemExit as exc:
                exit_code = exc.code if isinstance(exc.code, int) else 1
                transaction.set_tag("exit_code", str(exit_code))
                transaction.set_tag(
                    "outcome", "ok" if exit_code == 0 else "user_error"
                )
                transaction.set_status(
                    "ok" if exit_code == 0 else "invalid_argument"
                )
                failed = exit_code != 0
                raise
            except KeyboardInterrupt:
                transaction.set_tag("outcome", "cancelled")
                transaction.set_status("cancelled")
                failed = True
                raise
            except BaseException as exc:
                failed = True
                transaction.set_tag("outcome", "error")
                transaction.set_status("internal_error")
                report_exception(exc, command=command)
                raise
            else:
                transaction.set_tag("outcome", "ok")
                transaction.set_status("ok")
            finally:
                end_stage("error" if failed else "ok")
                transaction.set_measurement(
                    "doxify.command.duration_ms",
                    (time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000,
                    "millisecond",
                )
    finally:
        _current_transaction.reset(token)


@contextmanager
def span(name: str, *, op: str = "doxify.operation") -> Iterator[Span | None]:
    if not _status.enabled:
        yield None
        return
    with sentry_sdk.start_span(op=op, name=name) as current:
        yield current


@contextmanager
def model_span(
    *,
    provider: str,
    model: str,
    temperature: float | None = None,
    max_tokens: int | None = None,
) -> Iterator[Span | None]:
    if not _status.enabled:
        yield None
        return
    with sentry_sdk.start_span(op=OP.GEN_AI_CHAT, name="model.chat") as current:
        current.set_data(SPANDATA.GEN_AI_SYSTEM, "ollama")
        current.set_data(SPANDATA.GEN_AI_PROVIDER_NAME, provider)
        current.set_data(SPANDATA.GEN_AI_REQUEST_MODEL, model)

151:             synthetic.append(

156:                     status,

209:     body: list[str] = []
210:     in_fence = False

212:     for line in text.splitlines():

216:             body.append(line)

225:         body = []
226:

228:         sections.append((title, "\n".join(body)))

name: Doxify Verify
description: Verify Doxify sessions or evidence-marked READMEs and fail on unsupported claims.
author: Ekomjah
branding:
  icon: shield
  color: green

inputs:
  session:
    description: Compile session directory to verify.
    required: false
    default: ""
  artifact:
    description: README or case study file to audit.
    required: false
    default: ""
  evidence:
    description: Evidence JSON for artifact-only verification.
    required: false
    default: ""
  fail-on:
    description: Comma-separated claim statuses that fail the check.
    required: false
    default: needs_evidence,rejected
  python-version:
    description: Python version used to run Doxify.
    required: false
    default: "3.10"
  working-directory:
    description: Directory used to resolve session, artifact, and evidence paths.
    required: false
    default: "."

runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - name: Install uv
      uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v6
      with:
        python-version: ${{ inputs.python-version }}

    - name: Install Doxify
      shell: bash
      run: uv sync --frozen --no-dev --project "$GITHUB_ACTION_PATH"

    - name: Verify
      id: verify
      shell: bash
      working-directory: ${{ inputs.working-directory }}
      env:
        SENTRY_DSN: ""
        INPUT_SESSION: ${{ inputs.session }}
        INPUT_ARTIFACT: ${{ inputs.artifact }}
        INPUT_EVIDENCE: ${{ inputs.evidence }}
        INPUT_FAIL_ON: ${{ inputs.fail-on }}
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        args=(verify)
        if [[ -n "$INPUT_SESSION" ]]; then
          args+=("$INPUT_SESSION")
        fi
        if [[ -n "$INPUT_ARTIFACT" ]]; then
          args+=(--artifact "$INPUT_ARTIFACT")
        fi
        if [[ -n "$INPUT_EVIDENCE" ]]; then
          args+=(--evidence "$INPUT_EVIDENCE")
        fi
        args+=(--fail-on "$INPUT_FAIL_ON" --check)
        uv run --project "$GITHUB_ACTION_PATH" --no-sync doxify "${args[@]}"

# Doxify

Doxify compiles evidence-backed READMEs and portfolio case studies from local
git repositories. It also scouts breaking dependency upgrades against your
code.

The core pipeline is deterministic: scan the repository, build evidence cards,
generate prose from that evidence, verify every claim, and export the result.
The model only writes; the compiler checks.

<!-- doxify-attested: project description and positioning -->

## Install

Requires Python 3.10+ and git.

```bash
uv sync
uv run doxify --help
```

Or install the package and run `doxify` directly.

<!-- doxify-attested: installation instructions -->

## Local mode (default)

Local mode uses Ollama and `gemma3:1b`. Nothing about the repository leaves
your machine.

```bash
ollama serve
ollama pull gemma3:1b
doxify doctor
doxify readme /path/to/repo
```

<!-- doxify-attested: local setup and privacy behavior -->

## Cloud mode (no local Ollama install)

Cloud mode uses Ollama Cloud directly. You do not need the Ollama app, server,
or a downloaded model. You do need an API key.

```bash
export OLLAMA_API_KEY="your_api_key"
doxify doctor --provider cloud
doxify readme /path/to/repo --provider cloud
```

Cloud defaults to `gemma4:31b`. Override it with `--model` or `DOXIFY_MODEL`.

Cloud mode sends evidence cards (file paths, snippets, commit messages, and
dependency names) to Ollama Cloud. Do not use it for confidential repositories.
Cloud usage may incur charges.

Configuration:

| Setting | Flag | Environment variable | Default |
|---|---|---|---|

# Observability

Doxify is local-first. Sentry monitoring is **off by default** and only starts
when you provide an explicit `SENTRY_DSN`. Without a DSN, Doxify writes no
telemetry and does not contact Sentry.

When enabled, monitoring sends a deliberately narrow slice of operational data:
command errors, timings, redacted structured logs, and model/HTTP spans. It does
not send prompts, completions, repository contents, evidence text, environment
variables, user identity, cookies, request bodies, query strings, or local
absolute paths.

## Enable locally

```bash
export SENTRY_DSN="https://<key>@<host>/<project>"
export SENTRY_ENVIRONMENT="development"
export SENTRY_TRACES_SAMPLE_RATE="1.0"
doxify self-check --json
```

Disable it at any time with `DOXIFY_SENTRY=0` or an empty `SENTRY_DSN`. The
default sample rate is `0.2`; use `1.0` for a smoke test and lower values for
normal use.

## Configuration

| Variable | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `SENTRY_DSN` | unset | Opt-in switch. Monitoring never starts without it. |
| `DOXIFY_SENTRY` | `1` | Set to `0` to force monitoring off even with a DSN. |
| `SENTRY_ENVIRONMENT` | `development` | Sentry environment name. |
| `SENTRY_RELEASE` | `doxify@<version>` | Release name. |
| `SENTRY_TRACES_SAMPLE_RATE` | `0.2` | Transaction sample rate, clamped to `0..1`. |
| `SENTRY_SEND_LOGS` | `1` | Send WARNING+ structured logs as Sentry logs. |
| `SENTRY_MONITOR_SLUG` | unset | Default Sentry cron monitor slug. No check-in without a slug. |
| `SENTRY_DEBUG` | `0` | Print Sentry SDK debug output. Do not enable in CI. |
| `DOXIFY_LOG_LEVEL` | `WARNING` | Local log threshold (`DEBUG`, `INFO`, `WARNING`, ...). |
| `DOXIFY_LOG_FORMAT` | `human` | `human` or `json` stderr output. |

## What is collected

Errors:

- exception type and redacted message;
- sanitized stack frames with source context, local variables, and absolute
  paths removed;
- safe tags such as `command`, `stage`, `outcome`, `exit_code`, `provider`, and
  `model`;
- a `doxify` context containing only command, stage, and provider.

Traces:

- command transactions named `doxify.<command>`;
- stage spans, model spans, and HTTP client spans;
- safe measurements such as command duration, model duration, and token usage;
- safe span data limited to `doxify.*`, `gen_ai.*`, and HTTP method/status keys.

Logs:

- structured events such as `model.response` and `model.error`;
- only allowlisted fields (`model`, `provider`, `status`, token counts, duration,
  command, stage, exit code, and Scout summary counts);
- no prompt, completion, source snippet, or repository path.

The SDK is initialized with `data_collection` explicitly disabling user info,
cookies, request headers, request bodies, URL query params, GraphQL documents
and variables, GenAI inputs/outputs, database query data, queues, stack-frame
variables, and frame context lines. `default_integrations=False` avoids
automatic instrumentation that could collect more than intended.

## Dashboards

Create a `Doxify Observability` dashboard in the Sentry project with these
widgets:

| Widget | Dataset | Query / metric |
|---|---|---|
| Command errors | Errors | `event.type:error` grouped by `command` |
| Command latency | Traces | p50/p95 of `doxify.command.duration_ms` by `command` |

from __future__ import annotations

import re
import shutil
import tempfile
from collections.abc import Callable
from pathlib import Path

from .claims import extract_claims
from .defense import build_defense
from .errors import SessionError
from .exporter import (
    write_case_study,
    write_claims_json,
    write_defense,
    write_defense_json,
    write_evidence_json,
    write_sections_json,
    write_verification_json,
)
from .generator import GeneratedSection, generate_section, template_section
from .models import (
    CaseStudySection,
    CaseStudySentence,
    ClaimsDocument,
    ClaimStatus,
    CompileResult,
    DefenseDocument,
    EvidenceCard,
    RepoSummary,
    ScanResult,
    SectionsDocument,
    SessionManifest,
    VerificationReport,
)
from .ollama_client import OllamaClient
from .readme import (
    ReadmeResult,
    backup_readme,
    build_readme,
    resolve_readme_target,
)
from .retrieval import SECTION_SPECS, retrieve_evidence
from .scanner import scan_repository
from .session import (
    prepare_output_dir,
    read_model,
    utc_now,
    write_json,
    write_manifest,
    write_text,
)
from .verifier import attest_claim as mark_attested
from .verifier import summarize_claims, verify_claims

StageCallback = Callable[[str, str], None]

CASE_STUDY = "case-study.md"
DEFENSE = "defense.md"
EVIDENCE = "evidence.json"
SECTIONS = "sections.json"
CLAIMS = "claims.json"
VERIFICATION = "verification.json"
DEFENSE_JSON = "defense.json"
MANIFEST = "manifest.json"


def scan_only(
    repo_path: Path,
    output_dir: Path,
    *,
    model: str,
    on_stage: StageCallback | None = None,
    force: bool = False,
) -> tuple[RepoSummary, list[EvidenceCard], Path, SessionManifest]:
    emit = on_stage or (lambda _stage, _detail: None)
    emit("validate", "Checking repository path")
    _context, scan = scan_repository(repo_path)
    output = prepare_output_dir(output_dir, force=force)
    emit("scan", f"Collected {len(scan.evidence)} evidence cards")
    write_evidence_json(output, scan.repo, scan.evidence)

    now = utc_now()
    manifest = SessionManifest(
        created_at=now,
        updated_at=now,
        repo=scan.repo,
        model=model,
        provider="none",
        status="scanned",
    )
    write_manifest(output / MANIFEST, manifest, [EVIDENCE])
    emit("done", f"Evidence written to {output}")
    return scan.repo, scan.evidence, output, manifest


def compile_repo(
    repo_path: Path,
    output_dir: Path,
    *,
    client: OllamaClient,
    model: str,
    draft: str | None = None,
    role: str | None = None,
    on_stage: StageCallback | None = None,
    force: bool = False,
) -> CompileResult:
    emit = on_stage or (lambda _stage, _detail: None)
    emit("validate", "Checking repository and model")
    client.ensure_ready()
    _context, scan = scan_repository(repo_path)
    output = prepare_output_dir(output_dir, force=force)

    now = utc_now()
    manifest = SessionManifest(
        created_at=now,
        updated_at=now,
        repo=scan.repo,
        model=model,
        provider=client.provider,
        model_host=client.host,
        status="running",
    )
    write_manifest(output / MANIFEST, manifest, [])
    write_evidence_json(output, scan.repo, scan.evidence)
    emit("scan", f"Collected {len(scan.evidence)} evidence cards")

    sections: list[CaseStudySection] = []
    claims = []
    warnings: list[str] = []

    for index, spec in enumerate(SECTION_SPECS, start=1):
        emit("generate", f"[{index}/{len(SECTION_SPECS)}] Drafting {spec.title}")
        cards = retrieve_evidence(scan.evidence, spec, limit=3)
        if spec.id in {"snapshot", "problem", "reflection"}:
            generated = GeneratedSection(
                body=template_section(spec, cards),
                fallback_used=False,
            )
        else:
            generated = generate_section(
                client,
                spec,
                cards,
                repo_name=scan.repo.name,
                role=role,
                draft=draft,
            )
        if generated.fallback_used:
            warnings.append(f"{spec.title}: template fallback ({generated.error}).")
        section_claims = extract_claims(
            spec.id,
            generated.body,
            start_index=len(claims) + 1,
        )
        claims.extend(section_claims)
        sections.append(
            CaseStudySection(
                id=spec.id,
                title=spec.title,
                body=generated.body,
                sentences=[
                    CaseStudySentence(
                        text=claim.text,
                        claim_id=claim.id,
                        evidence_ids=claim.evidence_ids,
                    )
                    for claim in section_claims
                ],
            )
        )

    emit("verify", f"Verifying {len(claims)} claims")
    claims = verify_claims(claims, scan.evidence)
    summary = summarize_claims(
        claims,
        section_count=len(sections),
        evidence_count=len(scan.evidence),
    )

    emit("defense", "Building interview defense pack")
    defense = build_defense(
        client,
        sections,
        claims,
        scan.evidence,
        repo_name=scan.repo.name,
        use_model=False,
    )

    emit("export", "Writing Markdown and JSON artifacts")
    write_sections_json(output, sections)
    write_claims_json(output, claims, summary)
    write_verification_json(output, claims, summary)
    write_defense_json(output, defense)
    write_case_study(output, scan.repo, sections, scan.evidence, summary, claims)
    write_defense(output, scan.repo, defense)

    manifest.status = "done"
    manifest.warnings = warnings
    artifacts = [
        EVIDENCE,
        SECTIONS,
        CLAIMS,
        VERIFICATION,
        DEFENSE_JSON,
        CASE_STUDY,
        DEFENSE,
    ]
    write_manifest(output / MANIFEST, manifest, artifacts)
    emit("done", f"Session complete: {output}")

    return CompileResult(
        manifest=manifest,
        evidence=scan.evidence,
        sections=sections,
        claims=claims,
        defense=defense,
        summary=summary,
    )


def readme_repo(
    repo_path: Path,
    *,
    client: OllamaClient,
    model: str,
    output: Path | None = None,
    draft: str | None = None,
    role: str | None = None,
    force: bool = False,
    cleanup: bool = False,
    on_stage: StageCallback | None = None,
) -> ReadmeResult:
    emit = on_stage or (lambda _stage, _detail: None)
    safe_name = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9_.-]+", "-", repo_path.name) or "repository"
    session_dir = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=f"doxify-readme-{safe_name}-"))
    emit("prepare", f"Created temporary compile session: {session_dir}")

    result = compile_repo(
        repo_path,
        session_dir,
        client=client,
        model=model,
        draft=draft,
        role=role,
        on_stage=on_stage,
    )

    emit("readme", "Rendering evidence-backed README")
    content = build_readme(result, session_dir=session_dir)
    target = resolve_readme_target(
        Path(result.manifest.repo.path),
        output,
        force=force,
    )

    backup_path: Path | None = None
    if target.exists():
        emit("backup", f"Backing up existing README to {session_dir / 'backups'}")
        backup_path = backup_readme(target, session_dir)

    emit("write", f"Writing README to {target}")
    write_text(target, content)

    omitted = [
        claim
        for claim in result.claims
        if claim.status not in {ClaimStatus.VERIFIED, ClaimStatus.ATTESTED}
    ]
    readme_result = ReadmeResult(
        path=target,
        session_dir=session_dir,
        content=content,
        compile_result=result,
        omitted_claims=omitted,
        warnings=list(result.manifest.warnings),
        backup_path=backup_path,
    )

    if cleanup:
        emit("cleanup", f"Removing temporary compile session: {session_dir}")
        shutil.rmtree(session_dir, ignore_errors=True)
        readme_result.session_cleaned = True

    emit("done", f"README written to {target}")
    return readme_result


def load_session(output_dir: Path) -> tuple[ScanResult, SectionsDocument, ClaimsDocument, DefenseDocument, SessionManifest]:
    output = output_dir.expanduser().resolve()
    if not output.is_dir():
        raise SessionError(f"Session directory does not exist: {output}")
    scan = read_model(output / EVIDENCE, ScanResult)
    sections = read_model(output / SECTIONS, SectionsDocument)
    claims = read_model(output / CLAIMS, ClaimsDocument)
    defense = read_model(output / DEFENSE_JSON, DefenseDocument)
    manifest = read_model(output / MANIFEST, SessionManifest)
    return scan, sections, claims, defense, manifest


def load_evidence_file(path: Path) -> ScanResult:
    return read_model(path.expanduser().resolve(), ScanResult)


def verify_session(output_dir: Path, *, write: bool = True) -> VerificationReport:
    output = output_dir.expanduser().resolve()
    scan, sections, claims_doc, defense, manifest = load_session(output)
    claims = verify_claims(claims_doc.claims, scan.evidence)
    summary = summarize_claims(
        claims,
        section_count=len(sections.sections),
        evidence_count=len(scan.evidence),
    )
    report = VerificationReport(summary=summary, claims=claims)
    if not write:
        return report

    write_claims_json(output, claims, summary)
    write_json(output / VERIFICATION, report)
    write_case_study(output, scan.repo, sections.sections, scan.evidence, summary, claims)
    write_defense(output, scan.repo, defense.questions)
    manifest.status = "verified"
    write_manifest(
        output / MANIFEST,
        manifest,
        [EVIDENCE, SECTIONS, CLAIMS, VERIFICATION, DEFENSE_JSON, CASE_STUDY, DEFENSE],
    )
    return report


def attest_session(output_dir: Path, claim_id: str, answer: str) -> VerificationReport:
    output = output_dir.expanduser().resolve()
    scan, sections, claims_doc, defense, manifest = load_session(output)
    try:
        mark_attested(claims_doc.claims, claim_id, answer)
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise SessionError(str(exc)) from exc
    claims = verify_claims(claims_doc.claims, scan.evidence)
    summary = summarize_claims(
        claims,
        section_count=len(sections.sections),
        evidence_count=len(scan.evidence),
    )
    write_claims_json(output, claims, summary)
    report = VerificationReport(summary=summary, claims=claims)
    write_json(output / VERIFICATION, report)
    write_case_study(output, scan.repo, sections.sections, scan.evidence, summary, claims)
    write_defense(output, scan.repo, defense.questions)
    manifest.status = "attested"
    write_manifest(
        output / MANIFEST,
        manifest,
        [EVIDENCE, SECTIONS, CLAIMS, VERIFICATION, DEFENSE_JSON, CASE_STUDY, DEFENSE],
    )
    return report


def export_session(output_dir: Path) -> Path:
    output = output_dir.expanduser().resolve()
    scan, sections, claims_doc, defense, manifest = load_session(output)
    summary = claims_doc.summary
    write_sections_json(output, sections.sections)
    write_claims_json(output, claims_doc.claims, summary)
    write_verification_json(output, claims_doc.claims, summary)
    write_defense_json(output, defense.questions)
    write_case_study(output, scan.repo, sections.sections, scan.evidence, summary, claims_doc.claims)
    write_defense(output, scan.repo, defense.questions)
    manifest.status = "exported"
    write_manifest(
        output / MANIFEST,
        manifest,
        [EVIDENCE, SECTIONS, CLAIMS, VERIFICATION, DEFENSE_JSON, CASE_STUDY, DEFENSE],
    )
    return output

Let me check `prepare_output_dir` behavior with fresh temp dir — fine. But the `force` flag for --force in readme command is intended for overwriting README; it's also passed into compile_repo. Not a bug per se.

Potential real bug: readme_repo creates session dir in /tmp, then `resolve_readme_target(Path(result.manifest.repo.path), output, force=force)`; writes README; emits into console. Cleanup optional. But on failure (compile error) the temp session dir is left behind (not cleaned). Minor.

Another: readme_repo's `session_dir` is inside /tmp; build_readme embeds evidence markers? Fine.

Bigger: `verify_session` calls `load_session` which requires defense.json — README-only usage irrelevant.

Watch for `write_manifest` and `prepare_output_dir` semantics.

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path

from .evidence import build_evidence
from .git_repo import RepoContext, collect_repo_context, open_repo
from .models import ScanResult


def scan_repository(
    path: Path,
    *,
    max_commits: int = 100,
    max_cards: int = 60,
    max_file_bytes: int = 120_000,
) -> tuple[RepoContext, ScanResult]:
    repo = open_repo(path)
    context = collect_repo_context(repo, max_commits=max_commits)
    cards = build_evidence(
        context,
        max_cards=max_cards,
        max_file_bytes=max_file_bytes,
    )
    return context, ScanResult(repo=context.summary, evidence=cards)

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re

try:
    import tomllib
except ModuleNotFoundError:  # Python 3.10
    import tomli as tomllib
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import PurePosixPath

from .git_repo import RepoContext
from .models import EvidenceCard, EvidenceKind, EvidenceRef, EvidenceStrength
from .paths import is_manifest, is_readme, is_secret, is_skippable, read_text_limited
from .text import compact_whitespace, keywords_for

JS_SYMBOL_RE = re.compile(
    r"^\s*export\s+(?:default\s+)?(?:async\s+)?(?:function|const|class)\s+([A-Za-z_$][\w$]*)",
    re.MULTILINE,
)
PY_SYMBOL_RE = re.compile(r"^\s*(?:async\s+)?(?:def|class)\s+([A-Za-z_]\w*)", re.MULTILINE)
TOOL_NAME_RE = re.compile(r"^\s*name:\s*[\"']([^\"']+)[\"']", re.MULTILINE)
MONGOOSE_MODEL_RE = re.compile(r"mongoose\.model\(\s*[\"']([^\"']+)[\"']")
ROUTE_RE = re.compile(
    r"\b(?:router|app)\.(?:get|post|put|patch|delete)\(\s*[\"']([^\"']+)[\"']"
)

KEY_SOURCE_NAMES = {
    "index.js",
    "index.ts",
    "main.py",
    "app.py",
    "app.js",
    "app.ts",
    "server.js",
    "server.ts",
    "cli.py",
    "match.js",
    "match.ts",
    "filter.js",
    "filter.ts",
    "tools.js",
    "tools.ts",
    "prompt.js",
    "prompt.ts",
    "resource.js",
    "resource.ts",
    "models.py",
    "db.js",
    "db.ts",
}


@dataclass
class _SourceFile:
    relative: str
    text: str
    lines: list[str]


class _Factory:
    def __init__(self, max_cards: int) -> None:
        self.max_cards = max_cards
        self.cards: list[EvidenceCard] = []

    def add(
        self,
        *,
        kind: EvidenceKind,
        title: str,
        text: str,
        strength: EvidenceStrength,
        refs: list[EvidenceRef] | None = None,
        quote: str | None = None,
        keywords: list[str] | None = None,
        meta: dict[str, object] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        if len(self.cards) >= self.max_cards:
            return
        card = EvidenceCard(
            id=f"E{len(self.cards) + 1}",
            kind=kind,
            title=title,
            text=compact_whitespace(text),
            quote=compact_whitespace(quote) if quote else None,
            refs=refs or [],
            strength=strength,
            keywords=keywords or keywords_for(f"{title} {text} {quote or ''}"),
            meta=meta or {},
        )
        self.cards.append(card)


def build_evidence(
    context: RepoContext,
    *,
    max_cards: int = 60,
    max_file_bytes: int = 120_000,
) -> list[EvidenceCard]:
    factory = _Factory(max_cards)

    _identity_cards(factory, context)
    _readme_card(factory, context, max_file_bytes)
    _manifest_cards(factory, context, max_file_bytes)
    _directory_card(factory, context)

    sources = _read_sources(context, max_file_bytes)
    _tool_card(factory, sources)
    _model_card(factory, sources)
    _route_card(factory, sources)
    _data_cards(factory, context, max_file_bytes)
    _test_card(factory, context)
    _deploy_card(factory, context)
    _commit_cards(factory, context)
    _source_excerpt_cards(factory, sources)

    return factory.cards


def _identity_cards(factory: _Factory, context: RepoContext) -> None:
    summary = context.summary
    refs = [EvidenceRef(commit=summary.head_sha)] if summary.head_sha else []
    timeline = (
        f"{summary.name} has {summary.commit_count} commits"
        f" between {summary.first_commit_date} and {summary.last_commit_date}."
        if summary.first_commit_date and summary.last_commit_date
        else f"{summary.name} has {summary.commit_count} commits."
    )
    factory.add(
        kind=EvidenceKind.METRIC,
        title="Commit timeline",
        text=timeline,
        refs=refs,
        strength=EvidenceStrength.DETERMINISTIC,
        keywords=["commits", "timeline", "history", "dates"],
        meta={
            "commit_count": summary.commit_count,
            "first_commit_date": summary.first_commit_date,
            "last_commit_date": summary.last_commit_date,
        },
    )

    languages = ", ".join(
        f"{name} ({count})" for name, count in list(summary.languages.items())[:5]
    )
    language_text = (
        f"The repository tracks {summary.tracked_file_count} files"
        + (f", with languages {languages}." if languages else ".")
    )
    factory.add(
        kind=EvidenceKind.METRIC,
        title="Repository size and languages",
        text=language_text,
        strength=EvidenceStrength.DETERMINISTIC,
        keywords=["files", "languages", "repository", "size"],
        meta={"tracked_file_count": summary.tracked_file_count},
    )


def _readme_card(factory: _Factory, context: RepoContext, max_file_bytes: int) -> None:
    readme = context.summary.readme_path
    if not readme:
        factory.add(
            kind=EvidenceKind.METRIC,
            title="No README",
            text="No README file was found among the tracked files.",
            strength=EvidenceStrength.DETERMINISTIC,
            keywords=["readme", "documentation", "missing"],
        )
        return

    source = _read_source(context, readme, max_file_bytes)
    if not source:
        factory.add(
            kind=EvidenceKind.README,
            title="README present",
            text=f"The repository contains a README at {readme}.",
            refs=[EvidenceRef(path=readme)],
            strength=EvidenceStrength.README,
            keywords=["readme", "documentation"],
        )
        return

    quote = "\n".join(source.lines[:18])
    factory.add(
        kind=EvidenceKind.README,
        title="README present",
        text=f"The repository contains a README at {readme}.",
        refs=[EvidenceRef(path=readme, lines="1-18")],
        quote=quote,
        strength=EvidenceStrength.README,
        meta={"path": readme},
    )


def _manifest_cards(factory: _Factory, context: RepoContext, max_file_bytes: int) -> None:
    manifests = context.summary.manifests
    if not manifests:
        return

    dependencies: list[str] = []
    scripts: list[str] = []
    for relative in manifests:
        source = _read_source(context, relative, max_file_bytes)
        if not source:
            continue
        if relative.endswith("package.json"):
            try:
                data = json.loads(source.text)
            except json.JSONDecodeError:
                continue
            dependencies.extend(sorted((data.get("dependencies") or {}).keys()))
            scripts.extend(sorted((data.get("scripts") or {}).keys()))
        elif relative.endswith("pyproject.toml"):
            try:
                data = tomllib.loads(source.text)
            except tomllib.TOMLDecodeError:
                continue
            project = data.get("project") or {}
            dependencies.extend(list(project.get("dependencies") or []))
        elif relative.endswith("requirements.txt"):
            dependencies.extend(
                line.split("==")[0].strip()
                for line in source.text.splitlines()
                if line.strip() and not line.startswith("#")
            )

    unique_dependencies = sorted({dep.split("[")[0].split(">=")[0].strip() for dep in dependencies})
    if unique_dependencies:
        displayed = ", ".join(unique_dependencies[:12])
        factory.add(
            kind=EvidenceKind.STACK,
            title="Declared dependencies",
            text=f"The project declares runtime dependencies including {displayed}.",
            refs=[EvidenceRef(path=path) for path in manifests],
            strength=EvidenceStrength.DETERMINISTIC,
            keywords=keywords_for(" ".join(unique_dependencies)),
            meta={"dependencies": unique_dependencies},
        )

    if scripts:
        factory.add(
            kind=EvidenceKind.STACK,
            title="Project scripts",
            text=f"The project defines scripts named {', '.join(scripts)}.",
            refs=[EvidenceRef(path=path) for path in manifests if path.endswith("package.json")],
            strength=EvidenceStrength.DETERMINISTIC,
            keywords=["scripts", "commands", "test", "build", *scripts],
            meta={"scripts": scripts},
        )


def _directory_card(factory: _Factory, context: RepoContext) -> None:
    counts: dict[str, int] = {}
    for raw in context.tracked_files:
        relative = PurePosixPath(raw)
        if not relative.parts:
            continue
        top = relative.parts[0]
        counts[top] = counts.get(top, 0) + 1
    if not counts:
        return
    top_dirs = ", ".join(
        f"{name} ({count})" for name, count in sorted(counts.items(), key=lambda item: -item[1])[:8]
    )
    factory.add(
        kind=EvidenceKind.FILE,
        title="Top-level structure",
        text=f"The repository is organized into these top-level paths: {top_dirs}.",
        strength=EvidenceStrength.DETERMINISTIC,
        keywords=["architecture", "directories", "structure", "modules"],
        meta={"top_level": counts},
    )


def _read_sources(context: RepoContext, max_file_bytes: int) -> list[_SourceFile]:
    sources: list[_SourceFile] = []
    for relative in context.tracked_files:
        pure = PurePosixPath(relative)
        if is_readme(pure) or is_manifest(pure) or is_secret(pure) or is_skippable(pure):
            continue
        if pure.suffix.lower() not in {".py", ".js", ".ts", ".jsx", ".tsx", ".go", ".rs", ".java"}:
            continue
        source = _read_source(context, relative, max_file_bytes)
        if source:
            sources.append(source)
        if len(sources) >= 180:
            break
    return sources


def _tool_card(factory: _Factory, sources: list[_SourceFile]) -> None:
    best: tuple[_SourceFile, list[re.Match[str]]] | None = None
    for source in sources:
        matches = list(TOOL_NAME_RE.finditer(source.text))
        if (
            len(matches) >= 2
            and ("TOOLS" in source.text or "tool" in source.relative.lower())
            and (best is None or len(matches) > len(best[1]))
        ):
            best = (source, matches)
    if best is None:
        return

    source, matches = best
    names = [match.group(1) for match in matches]
    start_line = _line_number(source.text, matches[0].start())
    end_line = _line_number(source.text, matches[-1].end())
    quote = "\n".join(source.lines[start_line - 1 : min(end_line, start_line + 24)])
    factory.add(
        kind=EvidenceKind.CODE,
        title=f"{len(names)} registered tools",
        text=(
            f"{source.relative} registers {len(names)} tools: "
            f"{', '.join(names)}."
        ),
        refs=[EvidenceRef(path=source.relative, lines=f"{start_line}-{end_line}")],
        quote=quote,
        strength=EvidenceStrength.CODE,
        keywords=["tools", "mcp", "commands", *names],
        meta={"tool_count": len(names), "tool_names": names},
    )


def _model_card(factory: _Factory, sources: list[_SourceFile]) -> None:
    found: list[tuple[str, str, int]] = []
    for source in sources:
        for match in MONGOOSE_MODEL_RE.finditer(source.text):
            found.append((source.relative, match.group(1), _line_number(source.text, match.start())))
    if not found:
        return

    names = [name for _, name, _ in found]
    refs = _dedupe_refs(
        [EvidenceRef(path=path, lines=str(line)) for path, _, line in found]
    )
    factory.add(
        kind=EvidenceKind.CODE,
        title=f"{len(names)} database models",
        text=f"The repository defines {len(names)} Mongoose models: {', '.join(names)}.",
        refs=refs,
        strength=EvidenceStrength.CODE,
        keywords=["models", "database", "mongoose", "schema", *names],
        meta={"model_count": len(names), "model_names": names},
    )


def _route_card(factory: _Factory, sources: list[_SourceFile]) -> None:
    routes: list[str] = []
    for source in sources:
        routes.extend(match.group(1) for match in ROUTE_RE.finditer(source.text))
    if not routes:
        return
    unique = list(dict.fromkeys(routes))
    factory.add(
        kind=EvidenceKind.CODE,
        title=f"{len(unique)} HTTP routes",
        text=f"The repository declares {len(unique)} HTTP routes including {', '.join(unique[:10])}.",
        strength=EvidenceStrength.CODE,
        keywords=["routes", "http", "api", "endpoints", *unique[:10]],
        meta={"route_count": len(unique)},
    )


def _data_cards(factory: _Factory, context: RepoContext, max_file_bytes: int) -> None:
    for relative in context.tracked_files:
        pure = PurePosixPath(relative)
        if pure.suffix.lower() != ".json" or is_manifest(pure):
            continue
        lower = relative.lower()
        if not any(part in lower for part in ("data/", "seed", "catalog", "fixture")):
            continue
        source = _read_source(context, relative, max_file_bytes)
        if not source:
            continue
        try:
            data = json.loads(source.text)
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            continue
        if not isinstance(data, list):
            continue
        factory.add(
            kind=EvidenceKind.METRIC,
            title=f"{len(data)} records in {relative}",
            text=f"{relative} contains {len(data)} JSON records.",
            refs=[EvidenceRef(path=relative)],
            strength=EvidenceStrength.DETERMINISTIC,
            keywords=["records", "data", "seed", "catalog", relative],
            meta={"record_count": len(data), "data_path": relative},
        )


def _test_card(factory: _Factory, context: RepoContext) -> None:
    tests = context.summary.test_files
    if not tests:
        return
    factory.add(
        kind=EvidenceKind.TEST,
        title=f"{len(tests)} test-related files",
        text=f"The repository contains test-related files: {', '.join(tests[:12])}.",
        refs=[EvidenceRef(path=path) for path in tests[:12]],
        strength=EvidenceStrength.CODE,
        keywords=["tests", "testing", "smoke", "verification", *tests[:8]],
        meta={"test_count": len(tests), "test_files": tests},
    )


def _deploy_card(factory: _Factory, context: RepoContext) -> None:
    deploys = context.summary.deploy_files
    if not deploys:
        return
    factory.add(
        kind=EvidenceKind.DEPLOY,
        title="Deployment configuration",
        text=f"The repository contains deployment or CI files: {', '.join(deploys[:12])}.",
        refs=[EvidenceRef(path=path) for path in deploys[:12]],
        strength=EvidenceStrength.CODE,
        keywords=["deployment", "docker", "ci", "deploy", *deploys[:8]],
        meta={"deploy_files": deploys},
    )


def _commit_cards(factory: _Factory, context: RepoContext) -> None:
    for commit in context.commits[:10]:
        factory.add(
            kind=EvidenceKind.COMMIT,
            title=f"Commit on {commit.date}",
            text=f'Commit {commit.hexsha} on {commit.date} has subject "{commit.subject}".',
            refs=[EvidenceRef(commit=commit.hexsha)],
            quote=commit.subject,
            strength=EvidenceStrength.COMMIT,
            keywords=keywords_for(commit.subject),
            meta={"commit": commit.hexsha, "date": commit.date, "subject": commit.subject},
        )


def _source_excerpt_cards(factory: _Factory, sources: list[_SourceFile]) -> None:
    selected: list[_SourceFile] = []
    for source in sources:
        if PurePosixPath(source.relative).name in KEY_SOURCE_NAMES:
            selected.append(source)
    for source in sources:
        if source not in selected and len(selected) < 14:
            selected.append(source)
        if len(selected) >= 14:
            break

    for source in selected[:14]:
        symbols = _symbols(source)
        quote, start, end = _excerpt(source, symbols)
        if not quote:
            continue
        label = f"defines {', '.join(symbols[:6])}" if symbols else f"contains {len(source.lines)} lines"
        factory.add(
            kind=EvidenceKind.CODE,
            title=f"Source: {source.relative}",
            text=f"{source.relative} {label}.",
            refs=[EvidenceRef(path=source.relative, lines=f"{start}-{end}")],
            quote=quote,
            strength=EvidenceStrength.CODE,
            keywords=keywords_for(f"{source.relative} {' '.join(symbols)}"),
            meta={"path": source.relative, "symbols": symbols, "line_start": start, "line_end": end},
        )


def _symbols(source: _SourceFile) -> list[str]:
    matches = [
        *JS_SYMBOL_RE.finditer(source.text),
        *PY_SYMBOL_RE.finditer(source.text),
    ]
    return list(dict.fromkeys(match.group(1) for match in matches))[:10]


def _excerpt(source: _SourceFile, symbols: list[str]) -> tuple[str, int, int]:
    text = source.text
    start = 1
    if symbols:
        match = re.search(rf"\b{re.escape(symbols[0])}\b", text)
        if match:
            start = max(1, _line_number(text, match.start()) - 2)
    end = min(len(source.lines), start + 18)
    quote = "\n".join(source.lines[start - 1 : end])
    return quote[:1500], start, end


def _read_source(context: RepoContext, relative: str, max_file_bytes: int) -> _SourceFile | None:
    path = context.root / relative
    try:
        resolved = path.resolve(strict=True)
    except OSError:
        return None
    if not resolved.is_relative_to(context.root):
        return None
    text = read_text_limited(resolved, max_file_bytes)
    if text is None:
        return None
    return _SourceFile(relative=relative, text=text, lines=text.splitlines())


def _line_number(text: str, index: int) -> int:
    return text.count("\n", 0, index) + 1


def _dedupe_refs(refs: list[EvidenceRef]) -> list[EvidenceRef]:
    seen: set[tuple[str | None, str | None, str | None]] = set()
    result: list[EvidenceRef] = []
    for ref in refs:
        key = (ref.path, ref.lines, ref.commit)
        if key in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(key)
        result.append(ref)
    return result

- The scanner is JS/MCP-centric: TOOL_NAME_RE requires YAML `name:` in TS, MONGOOSE_MODEL_RE, ROUTE_RE for JS routers. For a Python CLI repo (doxify itself), tool/model/route cards mostly absent. Fine.

E.g. "typer>=0.27.3" → "typer". "tomli>=2.5.0; python_version < '3.11'" → "tomli>=2.5.0; python_version < '3.11'" split(">=")[0] → "tomli" good. "pydantic>=2.14.1" fine. But "ollama>=0.6.3" → "ollama". "uvicorn[standard]>=0.30" → "uvicorn". Mostly ok but markers with == e.g. "foo==1.0" → not stripped (split(">=") only) → "foo==1.0" appears. Minor.

from __future__ import annotations

from enum import Enum
from typing import Any

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field

SCHEMA_VERSION = "1.0"
TOOL_NAME = "doxify"


class EvidenceKind(str, Enum):
    METRIC = "metric"
    STACK = "stack"
    FILE = "file"
    CODE = "code"
    COMMIT = "commit"
    TEST = "test"
    DEPLOY = "deploy"
    README = "readme"
    ATTESTED = "attested"


class EvidenceStrength(str, Enum):
    DETERMINISTIC = "deterministic"
    CODE = "code"
    COMMIT = "commit"
    README = "readme"
    ATTESTED = "attested"


class ClaimStatus(str, Enum):
    VERIFIED = "verified"
    ATTESTED = "attested"
    NEEDS_EVIDENCE = "needs_evidence"
    REJECTED = "rejected"


class EvidenceRef(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    path: str | None = None
    lines: str | None = None
    commit: str | None = None
    url: str | None = None


class EvidenceCard(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    id: str
    kind: EvidenceKind
    title: str
    text: str
    quote: str | None = None
    refs: list[EvidenceRef] = Field(default_factory=list)
    strength: EvidenceStrength
    keywords: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    meta: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class CommitInfo(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    hexsha: str
    date: str
    subject: str


class RepoSummary(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    path: str
    name: str
    head_sha: str | None = None
    branch: str | None = None
    commit_count: int = 0
    first_commit_date: str | None = None
    last_commit_date: str | None = None
    tracked_file_count: int = 0
    languages: dict[str, int] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    readme_path: str | None = None
    manifests: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    test_files: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    deploy_files: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)


class ScanResult(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    schema_version: str = SCHEMA_VERSION
    repo: RepoSummary
    evidence: list[EvidenceCard] = Field(default_factory=list)


class Claim(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    id: str
    text: str
    section_id: str
    evidence_ids: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    status: ClaimStatus = ClaimStatus.NEEDS_EVIDENCE
    reason: str | None = None
    gap_question: str | None = None
    user_answer: str | None = None


class CaseStudySentence(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    text: str
    claim_id: str
    evidence_ids: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)


class CaseStudySection(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    id: str
    title: str
    body: str
    sentences: list[CaseStudySentence] = Field(default_factory=list)


class DefenseQuestion(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    id: str
    question: str
    why_asked: str
    answer_outline: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    evidence_ids: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    gap: str | None = None


class CompileSummary(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    verified: int = 0
    attested: int = 0
    needs_evidence: int = 0
    rejected: int = 0
    sections: int = 0
    evidence_cards: int = 0


class VerificationReport(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    schema_version: str = SCHEMA_VERSION
    summary: CompileSummary
    claims: list[Claim] = Field(default_factory=list)


class ClaimsDocument(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    schema_version: str = SCHEMA_VERSION
    summary: CompileSummary
    claims: list[Claim] = Field(default_factory=list)


class SectionsDocument(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    schema_version: str = SCHEMA_VERSION
    sections: list[CaseStudySection] = Field(default_factory=list)


class DefenseDocument(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    schema_version: str = SCHEMA_VERSION
    questions: list[DefenseQuestion] = Field(default_factory=list)


class SessionManifest(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    schema_version: str = SCHEMA_VERSION
    tool: str = TOOL_NAME
    tool_version: str = "0.1.0"
    created_at: str
    updated_at: str

The pattern is "poorly done": the evidence_lower checks are effectively no-ops for tests/deployment (both return the same), and the oauth check returns REJECTED when evidence lacks oauth (should be NEEDS_EVIDENCE? semantics). from __future__ import annotations

import re

TOKEN_RE = re.compile(r"[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_+-]*|\d[\d,]*")

STOPWORDS = {
    "a",
    "an",
    "and",
    "are",
    "as",
    "at",
    "be",
    "because",
    "by",
    "for",
    "from",
    "has",
    "have",
    "i",
    "in",
    "is",
    "it",
    "its",
    "of",
    "on",
    "or",
    "that",
    "the",
    "their",
    "this",
    "to",
    "was",
    "were",
    "which",
    "with",
    "project",
    "repository",
    "repo",
    "code",
    "file",
    "files",
    "using",
    "used",
    "uses",
    "use",
    "built",
    "build",
}


def tokenize(text: str) -> list[str]:
    return [match.group(0).lower() for match in TOKEN_RE.finditer(text)]


def stem(token: str) -> str:
    if len(token) <= 4 or token.isdigit():
        return token
    for suffix in ("ing", "ed", "es", "s"):
        if token.endswith(suffix) and len(token) - len(suffix) >= 3:
            return token[: -len(suffix)]
    return token


def content_tokens(text: str) -> set[str]:
    return {
        stem(token)
        for token in tokenize(text)
        if token not in STOPWORDS and len(token) > 1
    }


def token_sets_overlap(left: set[str], right: set[str]) -> bool:
    for first in left:
        for second in right:
            if first == second:
                return True
            if (
                len(first) >= 4
                and len(second) >= 4
                and (first.startswith(second) or second.startswith(first))
            ):
                return True
    return False


def keywords_for(text: str, limit: int = 10) -> list[str]:
    seen: list[str] = []
    for token in tokenize(text):
        if token in STOPWORDS or token in seen or len(token) < 2:
            continue
        seen.append(token)
        if len(seen) >= limit:
            break
    return seen


def compact_whitespace(text: str) -> str:
    return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text).strip()

from __future__ import annotations

from .models import EvidenceCard, SectionSpec
from .text import content_tokens

SECTION_SPECS: list[SectionSpec] = [
    SectionSpec(
        id="snapshot",
        title="Snapshot",
        goal="Summarize what the project is, its stack, size, and timeline.",
        keywords=["identity", "stack", "languages", "commits", "files", "readme"],
    ),
    SectionSpec(
        id="problem",
        title="The problem",
        goal="Explain the problem this project addresses and why it matters.",
        keywords=["problem", "purpose", "readme", "description", "context"],
    ),
    SectionSpec(
        id="approach",
        title="The approach",
        goal="Describe the main technical approach and major components.",
        keywords=["architecture", "structure", "approach", "tools", "models", "routes", "services"],
    ),
    SectionSpec(
        id="hard_part",
        title="The hard part",
        goal="Explain the hardest technical problem and how it was handled.",
        keywords=["match", "filter", "scoring", "validation", "refactor", "fix"],
    ),
    SectionSpec(
        id="shipped",
        title="What shipped",
        goal="Describe the concrete features, tools, routes, and tests that exist.",
        keywords=["tools", "features", "tests", "smoke", "routes", "models", "records"],
    ),
    SectionSpec(
        id="reflection",
        title="What I would change",
        goal="Name honest gaps, missing documentation, and sensible next steps.",
        keywords=["missing", "readme", "tests", "gap", "next", "deploy"],
    ),
]


def retrieve_evidence(
    cards: list[EvidenceCard],
    spec: SectionSpec,
    *,
    limit: int = 3,
) -> list[EvidenceCard]:
    if not cards:
        return []

    intent = content_tokens(
        " ".join([spec.title, spec.goal, *spec.keywords])
    )
    scored: list[tuple[float, int, EvidenceCard]] = []
    for index, card in enumerate(cards):
        card_tokens = content_tokens(
            " ".join([card.title, card.text, card.quote or "", *card.keywords])
        )
        overlap = len(intent & card_tokens)
        keyword_hits = sum(
            1 for keyword in spec.keywords if content_tokens(keyword) & card_tokens
        )
        score = float(overlap + keyword_hits * 2)
        if card.kind.value in {"metric", "stack"}:
            score += 0.5
        if card.kind.value == "commit":
            score -= 1.5
        if spec.id == "shipped" and any(
            key in card.meta
            for key in ("tool_count", "model_count", "route_count", "record_count", "test_count")
        ):
            score += 4
        if score > 0:
            scored.append((score, index, card))

    scored.sort(key=lambda item: (-item[0], item[1]))
    selected = [card for _, _, card in scored[:limit]]

    if len(selected) < min(3, len(cards)):
        selected_ids = {card.id for card in selected}
        for card in cards:
            if card.id not in selected_ids:
                selected.append(card)
                selected_ids.add(card.id)
            if len(selected) >= min(3, len(cards)):
                break

    return selected

from __future__ import annotations

from .models import EvidenceCard, SectionSpec

SYSTEM_PROMPT = """You are a technical portfolio editor working inside a compiler.

You will receive evidence cards and a section goal. You may only use the
evidence cards provided. You must cite evidence for every sentence using
tokens like [E1] or [E2][E5].

Rules:
- Never invent a number, user count, performance result, team size, award,
  deployment status, or security claim.
- Never claim tests pass, a project is production-ready, or a project is
  deployed unless an evidence card explicitly says so.
- If the evidence is insufficient, write a short gap sentence marked [GAP]
  followed by a specific question for the author.
- Prefer concrete, plain language over marketing language.
- Do not use phrases like "revolutionary", "seamless", "cutting-edge", or
  "game-changing".
- Write in first person when describing the developer's work.
- Keep sentences short.
- Do not start with "Okay", "Here is", "Certainly", or any conversational
  preamble. Start directly with the first factual sentence.
- Put each citation token immediately before the final period of the sentence.
- Write exactly two short paragraphs.
"""


def format_cards(cards: list[EvidenceCard]) -> str:
    blocks: list[str] = []
    for card in cards:
        refs = []
        for ref in card.refs:
            if ref.path:
                refs.append(ref.path + (f":{ref.lines}" if ref.lines else ""))
            elif ref.commit:
                refs.append(f"commit {ref.commit}")
        block = [
            f"[{card.id}] ({card.kind.value}) {card.title}",
            f"Fact: {card.text}",
        ]
        if card.quote:
            block.append(f"Quote: {card.quote[:350]}")
        if refs:
            block.append(f"Refs: {', '.join(refs)}")
        blocks.append("\n".join(block))
    return "\n\n".join(blocks)


def section_messages(
    spec: SectionSpec,
    cards: list[EvidenceCard],
    *,
    repo_name: str,
    role: str | None = None,
    draft: str | None = None,
) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
    user_parts = [
        f"Project: {repo_name}",
        f"Section: {spec.title}",
        f"Goal: {spec.goal}",
    ]
    if role:
        user_parts.append(f"Target role: {role}")
    if draft:
        user_parts.append(
            "Author notes (context only; do not treat as code evidence):\n"
            + draft.strip()[:4000]
        )
    user_parts.append("Evidence cards:\n" + format_cards(cards))
    user_parts.append(
        "Write exactly 2 short paragraphs for this section. "
        "Every sentence must end with one or more citation tokens. "
        "Do not write any preamble or heading. Start immediately with the content. "
        "If a sentence cannot be supported, write a [GAP] question instead. "
        "Return only the section text."
    )
    return [
        {"role": "system", "content": SYSTEM_PROMPT},
        {"role": "user", "content": "\n\n".join(user_parts)},
    ]


def repair_messages(
    spec: SectionSpec,
    cards: list[EvidenceCard],
    previous: str,
    problems: str,
) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
    return [
        {"role": "system", "content": SYSTEM_PROMPT},
        {
            "role": "user",
            "content": (
                f"Section: {spec.title}\n"
                f"Goal: {spec.goal}\n\n"
                f"The previous output had these problems:\n{problems}\n\n"
                "Rewrite the section using only the evidence cards below.\n"
                "Every sentence must cite evidence. Do not add new claims.\n\n"
                f"Evidence cards:\n{format_cards(cards)}\n\n"
                f"Previous output:\n{previous[:3000]}"
            ),
        },
    ]


SCOUT_SYSTEM_PROMPT = """You are a release-note analyst working inside a compiler.

Your job is to extract breaking changes from release notes, not to summarize
the release or recommend an upgrade.

Rules:
- Only include changes that can break existing code or require a migration.
- Every change must include a verbatim quote copied from the release notes.
- Every change must include at least one exact API, identifier, package path,
  or config key affected by the change.
- Do not invent APIs, versions, migration steps, or quotes.
- Do not include new features, bug fixes, performance improvements, or
  deprecations unless they require a code change.
- Ignore changes outside the requested package and version range.
- Return at most 8 changes. Prefer changes that affect named APIs.
- Keep each quote under 220 characters.
- If there are no breaking changes, return {"changes": []}.
- Return JSON only. Do not use Markdown fences or add an explanation.

Return a JSON object with one key, "changes". Its value must be an array of
strings. Each string must be one contiguous quote copied from the release
notes. Do not wrap a quote in another object, rewrite it, or combine separate
bullets. Return {"changes": []} when there are no breaking changes. Do not copy
instructions or examples into the output.
"""


def scout_batch_messages(
    package: str,
    from_version: str,
    to_version: str,
    excerpt: str,
) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
    return [
        {"role": "system", "content": SCOUT_SYSTEM_PROMPT},
        {
            "role": "user",
            "content": (
                f"Package: {package}\n"
                f"Upgrade: {from_version} -> {to_version}\n\n"
                "The excerpts are separated by release headers. Do not copy the "
                "headers into a quote.\n\n"
                "Release notes excerpts:\n"
                f"{excerpt[:11000]}\n\n"
                "Return only breaking-change lines that affect this upgrade. "
                "Copy each line exactly from the excerpt. Return JSON only."
            ),
        },
    ]


def defense_messages(
    repo_name: str,
    claims: list[dict[str, str]],
    evidence: list[EvidenceCard],
) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
    claim_text = "\n".join(
        f"- {claim['id']}: {claim['text']} [{', '.join(claim['evidence_ids'])}]"
        for claim in claims
    )
    return [
        {"role": "system", "content": SYSTEM_PROMPT},
        {
            "role": "user",
            "content": (
                f"Project: {repo_name}\n\n"
                "Using only the verified claims and evidence below, write 4-6 "
                "technical interview questions.\n\n"
                f"Claims:\n{claim_text}\n\n"
                f"Evidence:\n{format_cards(evidence)}\n\n"
                "Use exactly this format for each question:\n"
                "Q: <question>\n"
                "WHY: <why an interviewer asks it>\n"
                "- <answer outline bullet>\n"
                "- <answer outline bullet>\n"
                "- <answer outline bullet>\n"
                "EVIDENCE: E1, E2\n"
                "GAP: <missing information, or NONE>\n\n"
                "Do not invent outcomes or metrics. Return only the questions."
            ),
        },
    ]

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path

from rich.console import Console
from rich.progress import Progress, SpinnerColumn, TextColumn, TimeElapsedColumn
from rich.table import Table

from .models import CompileResult, RepoSummary, ScanResult
from .readme import ReadmeResult
from .scout import ScoutResult

console = Console()


def stage_progress():
    return Progress(
        SpinnerColumn(),
        TextColumn("[progress.description]{task.description}"),
        TimeElapsedColumn(),
        console=console,
        transient=False,
    )


def print_scan_summary(result: ScanResult, output: Path) -> None:
    table = Table(title="Scan complete", show_header=False)
    table.add_column("Field", style="cyan")
    table.add_column("Value")
    table.add_row("Repository", result.repo.name)
    table.add_row("Commits", str(result.repo.commit_count))
    table.add_row(
        "Timeline",
        f"{result.repo.first_commit_date or 'unknown'} to {result.repo.last_commit_date or 'unknown'}",
    )
    table.add_row("Tracked files", str(result.repo.tracked_file_count))
    table.add_row("README", result.repo.readme_path or "missing")
    table.add_row("Evidence cards", str(len(result.evidence)))
    table.add_row("Output", str(output))
    console.print(table)


def print_compile_summary(result: CompileResult, output: Path) -> None:
    summary = result.summary
    table = Table(title="Compile complete", show_header=False)
    table.add_column("Field", style="cyan")
    table.add_column("Value")
    table.add_row("Repository", result.manifest.repo.name)
    table.add_row(
        "Model",
        f"{result.manifest.model} ({result.manifest.provider})",
    )
    table.add_row("Sections", str(summary.sections))
    table.add_row("Evidence cards", str(summary.evidence_cards))
    table.add_row(
        "Claims",
        f"{summary.verified} verified, {summary.attested} attested, "
        f"{summary.needs_evidence} needing evidence, {summary.rejected} rejected",
    )
    table.add_row("Defense questions", str(len(result.defense)))
    table.add_row("Output", str(output))
    console.print(table)

    if summary.needs_evidence or summary.rejected:
        console.print(
            "\n[yellow]Review claims.json for gaps. Use `doxify attest DIR --claim C1 --answer ...` to label author context.[/yellow]"
        )


def print_readme_summary(result: ReadmeResult) -> None:
    summary = result.compile_result.summary
    table = Table(title="README complete", show_header=False)
    table.add_column("Field", style="cyan")
    table.add_column("Value")
    table.add_row("Repository", result.compile_result.manifest.repo.name)
    table.add_row("README", str(result.path))
    if result.session_cleaned:
        table.add_row("Compile session", f"removed ({result.session_dir})")
    else:
        table.add_row("Compile session", str(result.session_dir))
    table.add_row(
        "Claims",
        f"{summary.verified} verified, {summary.attested} attested, "
        f"{summary.needs_evidence} needing evidence, {summary.rejected} rejected",
    )
    table.add_row("Evidence cards", str(summary.evidence_cards))
    if result.backup_path is not None:
        table.add_row("Backup", str(result.backup_path))
    console.print(table)

    if result.omitted_claims:
        console.print(
            "\n[yellow]README omitted unresolved claims. Review claims.json in the "
            "compile session, then attest with `doxify attest SESSION --claim C1 --answer ...`.[/yellow]"
        )


def print_scout_summary(result: ScoutResult) -> None:
    report = result.report
    table = Table(title="Scout complete", show_header=False)
    table.add_column("Field", style="cyan")
    table.add_column("Value")
    table.add_row("Repository", report.repo.name)
    table.add_row("Upgrade", f"{report.package} {report.from_version} -> {report.to_version}")
    table.add_row("Release sources", str(report.summary.releases))
    changes_label = str(report.summary.changes)
    if report.summary.fallback_changes:
        changes_label += f" ({report.summary.fallback_changes} fallback)"
    table.add_row("Breaking changes", changes_label)
    table.add_row(
        "Touches you",
        f"{report.summary.touching} change(s), {report.summary.matches} code match(es)",
    )
    table.add_row("Files scanned", str(report.summary.files_scanned))
    if report.score:
        table.add_row(
            "Replay score",
            f"{len(report.score.extracted)}/{len(report.score.expected)} extracted, "
            f"{len(report.score.touched)}/{len(report.score.expected)} touching code",
        )
    table.add_row("Report", str(result.markdown_path))
    table.add_row("Session", str(result.output_dir))
    console.print(table)

    touching = [change for change in report.changes if change.matches]
    for change in touching[:5]:
        console.print(
            f"  [bold]{change.id}[/bold] {change.title} "
            f"({len(change.matches)} match(es))"
        )
    if len(touching) > 5:
        console.print(f"  ... and {len(touching) - 5} more in the report.")
    if not touching:
        console.print(
            "\n[yellow]No extracted breaking change matched the scanned files. "
            "Review the report before treating the upgrade as safe.[/yellow]"
        )
    if report.warnings:
        console.print(f"\n[yellow]{len(report.warnings)} warning(s) recorded in the report.[/yellow]")


def print_repo(repo: RepoSummary) -> None:
    console.print(
        f"[bold]{repo.name}[/bold] · {repo.commit_count} commits · "
        f"{repo.tracked_file_count} tracked files"
    )


def error(message: str) -> None:
    console.print(f"[red]Error:[/red] {message}")

                and not (current_path / name).is_symlink()
            ]
            for name in files:
                relative = (current_path / name).relative_to(root).as_posix()
